description: The project's private objects: values the simulated user personally holds (account numbers, member ids, credentials) that tests use and exploration can never find. Lists each category's name and description and each item's id, description and, for an item of several fields, the field names. Values are never returned, here or by any action; the user reads them in the app. Use set_private_objects to add or change them.

project.description: The project's number (as the app shows it, e.g. 12 or '#12') or its name. Optional when the organization has one project.
project.title: Project
